scripts.build: corepack pnpm build:electron && corepack pnpm build:renderer
scripts.build:electron: corepack pnpm build:native && node ../../scripts/prepare-dev-release.mjs && tsc -b tsconfig.electron.json --force && node ../../scripts/copy-electron-runtime-modules.mjs && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && node ../../scripts/build-p08-electron-e2e.mjs

scripts.dev:prepare: cross-env RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+crt-static -C link-arg=/Brepro" cargo build --locked -p aura-core -p aura-command-runner -p aura-execution-helper -p aura-execution-maintainer -p aura-sandbox-host -p aura-egress-proxy -p aura-elevated-helper && node ../../scripts/prepare-dev-release.mjs && node ../../scripts/dev-execution-preflight.mjs
scripts.dev:electron: corepack pnpm build:electron && wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5175 && cross-env NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 AURA_ALLOW_DEV_COMPONENT_MISMATCH=1 AURA_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5175 electron .
